scripts.name: Photo Palette
scripts.description: Pulls the main colours out of a photo and adds them as swatches with hex codes along its bottom edge.
scripts.author: Senyi Labs

scripts.name: Watermark
scripts.description: Adds a text watermark (corner, centre or repeated across the photo) to this document or every open one.
scripts.author: Senyi Labs

scripts.name: Contact Sheet
scripts.description: Puts every photo in a folder on a new A4 page in a grid, with file names: for proofs, picks and printing.
scripts.author: Senyi Labs
